notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
